copy.tagline: 按 DevOps 标准编写基础设施和自动化代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在写基础设施或自动化代码，需要遵循 DevOps 最佳实践。
copy.tagline_en: Write infrastructure and automation code following DevOps standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write infrastructure or automation code and need DevOps best practices.

howto.what: Claude 会遵循 DevOps 最佳实践编写基础设施和自动化代码，确保操作可重复、不可变基础设施、最小权限、秘密不提交到版本控制、状态远程锁定、CI/CD 流水线含审批门、监控和文档随代码生成。
howto.when: 当用户编写基础设施代码（如 Terraform、Ansible）或自动化脚本（如 Shell、YAML）时触发。

say.text: 为这个 Ansible 角色添加错误处理和标签，并检查幂等性。
say.note: Claude 会应用 Ansible 规则进行改进。

howto.what_en: Claude follows DevOps best practices when writing infrastructure and automation code: idempotent operations, immutable infrastructure, least privilege, secrets never in VCS, remote state with locking, CI/CD pipeline with approval gates, monitoring and docs as code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when writing infrastructure code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) or automation scripts (e.g., Shell, YAML).

say_en.text: Write a Terraform module for an AWS S3 bucket with immutability and versioning.
Add error handling and tags to this Ansible role, and check idempotency.
say_en.note: Claude applies Ansible rules to improve it.
